excluded_meshes.reason: The separate ray and four small underwater decorations are not octopus anatomy. They remain intact in the distributed source GLB.

numerical_proxy.method: Houdini PolyReduce 2.0; freeze topology before sampling source poses

motion.status: native Vellum source, 81-bone Dem Bones reconstruction, independent reopen and complete 48-frame Mantra animation accepted
motion.method: Houdini Vellum stretch and bend constraints, internal struts, compliant sparse arm-tip targets and contact generate 48 physical samples. Dem Bones fits an 8000-point fixed proxy with sparse weights and rigid transforms; native Point Deform transfers the fit to the original artist mesh. The sculpt contains no original animated rig or clip.

render_only_geometry.status: native posed hero, complete 48-frame animation and rest-surface controlled SSS study accepted
render_only_geometry.scale: Uniform presentation scale to metres; source units are not asserted to be metres.
render_only_geometry.axis_conversion: Convert source Y-up to the Z-up render study as an explicit presentation transform. Preserve numerical rest geometry, source poses and solver output.

materials.status: official Designer 16 cook/render accepted: editable SBS, SBSAR and 18 native 2K maps; repeated render byte hashes match
materials.method: New body and sucker surface appearance uses the original BaseColor as an input where needed to preserve eye and sucker regions. The distributed original PNG is unchanged.
